prompt: A 10-second continuous close-up. Coffee pours from a moka pot into a thick ceramic mug, steam rising immediately. Beside it, a piece of bread is torn open by hand, still warm, and butter is spread across it, melting on contact. Soft morning light through a window, a simple wooden table, calm and unhurried. Slow deliberate motion, the mug lifted slightly at the end. Audio: only natural ambience — coffee pouring, the crackle of bread crust, a spoon touching ceramic. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption:
Café e pão na manteiga.

Não tem receita. Não tem técnica. Não tem nada pra ensinar aqui.

Tem só o melhor momento do dia, e todo mundo sabe disso.

Segue pra mais cinco minutos de paz por dia 🍞
